_doc: Architecture guard config = the hexagonal contract. Signal 1 (domain noun / adapter-import in CORE) is a HARD FAIL. Signals 3 (core churn) and 7 (marginal cost + %-logic-in-md) are TREND metrics, reported not gated (co-evolution edits the core early; the alarm is a PLATEAU, not any single edit). Refining core-vs-adapter membership is itself part of the refactor.
_adapters_note: Domain adapters live in ../adapters/<domain>/ (migrated 2026-07-23). The published prismpath/ package is core-only; Signal-1 scans core_modules for domain_nouns. Each adapter conforms to adapters/ADAPTER_GUIDE.md.
_orchestration_note: The sprint and swarm machinery: the fallback orchestration layer for an organisation without one of its own (docs/design/control-plane.md). Kept in the package deliberately; not core, not an adapter, not gated by Signal-1.
_layout_note: Package layout (September 2026): kernel/, routing/, safety/, hotswap/, ledgers/, workers/, orchestration/, evals/, telemetry/; the old flat module names remain as shims that alias the same module objects.
_console_note: Mission Control is the operator's console (observe, control, events, prove); it consumes the ledgers and the kernel and is not core.
_triage_resolved_note: September 2026: analysis.py is kernel/ (static analysis), chat_agent.py is workers/ (a worker backend), ledger_runner.py is ledgers/ (a flow driven per item with a git proof), mission_control/ is the console.
